entries.german:
Ernst von Gottes gnaden
herzog zu Osterreich
Getrewer lieber. Vnser lieber getrewer Heinrich [?] von
Flednitz vnser hauptman in Steyer. hat vns gesagt
wie jhme der Edel vnser lieber getrewer der von Cilli
der elter habe geschriben. daz vnser Swager der Kunig
den satz den derselbe von Cilli zwischen sein vnd vns
vnd vnser baider landen gemacht etc. abgesagt habe
daz der an erichtag nach Reminiscere schierst kunfftig
ausgee. vnd welle mit vns selbst komben setz [?]
halten. daz wir doch vmb jhne nie haben verschuldt
daz wir vns aber mit gotes hilf wellen wider-
halten. vnd empfelhen dir. vnd begern ernstlich. daz du
dich darnach richtest. so du best mugst. wenn wir oder vnser
benanter [?] hauptman dir enbieten. daz du zu vns
ziehest zu ross vnd zu fuss. so du sterkest mügest.
vnd vns. vnser lannd vnd leut helffest zu erretten. als
du vns daz schuldig bist. daz wellen wir gegen dir er-
kennen. Geben zu der Newnstat am Suntag
Inuocauit in der vasten anno domini duo decimo
Vnsern getrewn lieben
Christoph der [?] Rosenberg
Abschrifft desselben von herzog
Ernst auß osterreich an Chri-
stoph Rosenberger de [?]
[?] × 1412
entries.english: Ernst, by the grace of God, Herzog of Austria. Dear loyal one, our dear loyal Heinrich [?] von Flednitz, our Hauptmann in Styria, has told us that the noble Cilli the Elder, our dear loyal one, wrote to him that our brother-in-law the King has renounced the Satz that the same Cilli made between him and us and both our lands, so that it expires on the Tuesday after Reminiscere next coming, and wants to come himself [?] and hold [?], although we have never given him cause for it, which we will resist with God's help. And we commend to you and earnestly request that you act accordingly: as best you can, when we or our aforementioned [?] Hauptmann summon you, that you come to us on horse and on foot, as strongly as you can, and help us save our land and people, as you are obliged to us. We will acknowledge this towards you. Given at Wiener Neustadt on the Sunday Invocavit in Lent, in the year [of the Lord] 1412. [Address:] To our dear loyal Christoph [?] Rosenberg. [Later hand, dorsum:] Copy of the same from Duke Ernst of Austria to Christoph Rosenberger [?].

entries.summary:
Herzog Ernst von Österreich fordert Christoph von Rosenberg auf den Bericht Friedrichs von Flädnitz, seines Hauptmanns in Steiermark, zur Heerfolge auf. Siegler: Aussteller

Siegel: 1 Sig. imp. beschädigt

entries.english: Ernst, by the grace of God Duke of Austria etc. […] told us how the noble Cilli, our dear loyal one, himself wrote to him [?] that the king has renounced the Satz that the same Cilli had made between him and us and both our lands, so that it expires on the Tuesday after Reminiscere next coming, and wants to come [against us?] himself, [?] although we have never given him cause for it, which we will resist with God's help. And we commend to you and earnestly request that you act accordingly: as best you can, when we or our aforementioned captain [?] summon you, that you come to us on horse and on foot, as strongly as you ever can [?], and help us save our land and people, as you are obliged to us. We will acknowledge this towards you. Given at Wiener Neustadt on the Sunday Invocavit in Lent, in the year of the Lord etc. 1412. [Address:] To our loyal Kristoff the Rosemberger.

facts.content: was requested by Herzog Ernst von Österreich to come to him on horse and on foot and help save his land and people.
